title: Unique Friend | Shulex CEO: AI Helping Tens of Millions of Global Brands Grow
summary: Product: Shulex VOC — ChatGPT/AI-based omnichannel Voice-of-Customer insight platform. Mines global consumer voice for product development, selling-point optimization, and competitive analysis — to ship hits faster and build brands that land. 100,000+ users; customers include

html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend Q&A · October 11, 2024 · Guest: CEO, Shulex

Product: Shulex VOC — ChatGPT/AI-based omnichannel Voice-of-Customer insight platform. Mines global consumer voice for product development, selling-point optimization, and competitive analysis — to ship hits faster and build brands that land. 100,000+ users; customers include Anker Innovations, Lee Kum Kee, Bybit, Alibaba, Worthfind, Huaqing, Juying, and others. Moat thesis: Shulex holds one of the densest Amazon-review corpora on the open web; AI can analyze products more completely.

AI customer-service bot: ChatGPT/AI robot that learns a knowledge base quickly and answers accurately — 24×7 for routine questions, returns/exchanges, troubleshooting, product recommendations, and other complex CS needs. Cuts cost and lifts service efficiency across e-commerce, finance, CPG, home, and more. Customers include Anker, Yuanren Tech, Yuanding Intelligence, Ruisi Jichuang, Guogui Racing, etc. Differentiation: in-house small-model-backed e-commerce Agent that can run complex industry CS SOPs.

GenAI / GTM / pricing: Products are designed on GenAI; GTM and pricing adjust with that stack. Automated design and personalization speed iteration and UX; AI generates personalized marketing copy, market materials, and real-time customer dialogue so teams can retune product and service in market.

Tech lead: Stay customer-experience-first; go deep in industry; serve global e-commerce brands; learn demand; ship product.

Ecosystem: Model vendors and upstream/downstream partners are complementary. Shulex picks models per customer need and supports both sides so customers actually get AI into production.

Challenges / markets: Global AI still growing fast. China expands under policy, data, and broad adoption — big tech and startups side by side, with focus on AV, smart cities, agents, etc. Overseas markets put more weight on AI ethics and regulation (e.g. EU AI Act). Cross-border exchange continues to push the market.

2024 watch: Edge computing and distributed cloud as IoT grows (manufacturing, smart cities, AV — lower latency, higher efficiency). Quantum computing still early but attracting capital/research for drug discovery, finance optimization, materials. Green tech and energy innovation — renewables, next-gen storage, carbon capture; NEVs (incl. hydrogen), smart grids, energy management under climate policy.

— END —
